boards.school_name: Massachusetts College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences
boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Boston-campus spaces for quiet work, computer use, or collaborative sessions, with MCPHS-stated features and access details.

cards.title: Set up in the Matricaria Lobby
cards.subtitle: Matricaria Academic and Student Center
cards.notes: Use the couches, chairs, tables, or benches for a casual work session; MCPHS lists seating for small groups and 24-hour access.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour lobby with soft seating and tables for flexible solo or shared work.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS lists the Matricaria lobby as a 24-hour study space with soft seating, tables, and benches.
cards.access_notes: MCPHS states that the lobby is open 24 hours.

cards.title: Work from the Henrietta DeBenedictis Library
cards.subtitle: Matricaria Academic and Student Center, second floor
cards.notes: Choose high-top tables, couches, carrels, or a group room; book group rooms only while the Circulation Desk is open.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour library with varied seating, quiet study, and reservable group rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS says the library has high-top tables, couches, group study rooms, carrels, and a Quiet Study space; the space is open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: The library space is open 24/7; study rooms are bookable only when the Circulation Desk is open.

cards.title: Claim a carrel in Quiet Study 3017
cards.subtitle: Matricaria Academic and Student Center, third floor
cards.notes: Use one of the individual carrels for focused reading; the three tutoring rooms may be used for groups when tutoring is not using them.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour quiet room with 40 individual carrels and tutoring rooms that can open to group study.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS identifies room 3017 for individual quiet study, with 40 carrels and three six-seat tutoring rooms available for group study when unused.
cards.access_notes: MCPHS lists the space as open 24 hours; tutoring rooms are conditional on availability.

cards.title: Settle into Quiet Study 3009
cards.subtitle: Matricaria Academic and Student Center, third floor
cards.notes: Use this room when you need an individual carrel rather than a group setting; MCPHS lists 62 carrels and 24-hour availability.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour individual quiet-study room with 62 carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS identifies room 3009 as an individual quiet-study space with 62 study carrels and 24-hour hours.
cards.access_notes: MCPHS lists the space as open 24 hours.

cards.title: Use a docking station at the Technology Center
cards.subtitle: Matricaria Academic and Student Center, third floor
cards.notes: Bring work that needs a campus computer setup; the center is designed for individual computer use and has printers and docking stations.
cards.short_summary: A computer-focused study setting with 68 docking stations and three printers.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS says the third-floor Technology Center is designed for individual computer use and has three printers and 68 docking stations.
cards.access_notes: MCPHS identifies this as a space for individual computer use; no separate hours are stated on the study-spaces page.

cards.title: Meet at the King Study and Social Center
cards.subtitle: White Building, WB21
cards.notes: Use the room for group work or individual computer tasks; MCPHS also permits individual study here and lists 24-hour access.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour White Building space for group work, individual computer use, or solo study.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS says King Study and Social Center (WB21) suits group study and individual computer use and may be used for individual study; it is open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: MCPHS lists King Study and Social Center (WB21) as open 24 hours.

cards.title: Spread out in the third-floor White Hall Foyer
cards.subtitle: White Building, third floor
cards.notes: Bring collaborators to the round study tables; MCPHS describes eight tables seating up to 34 people and 24-hour access.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour foyer arranged around eight round tables for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS describes the third-floor White Hall foyer as collaborative group-study space with eight round tables seating up to 34 students; it is open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: MCPHS lists the third-floor White Hall foyer as open 24 hours.

cards.title: Work from the Cardinal Lounge
cards.subtitle: Fennell Building, first floor
cards.notes: Use this social study space for work that can coexist with conversation and food; MCPHS lists it among spaces open around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Fennell first-floor lounge for studying and socializing, with computer access listed.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS lists Cardinal Lounge on Fennell's first floor as a 24-hour group-study and study-and-socialize space, and as a space with computers and printers.
cards.access_notes: MCPHS lists Cardinal Lounge as open 24 hours and permits food in spaces designated for studying and socializing.

cards.title: Gather in the Fennell Atrium
cards.subtitle: Fennell Building, first floor
cards.notes: Use the atrium for a discussion-based session where food is allowed; MCPHS includes it in its group study and study-and-socialize lists.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour first-floor atrium for group study and social work sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS lists the first-floor Fennell Atrium as a 24-hour group-study and study-and-socialize space where food is allowed.
cards.access_notes: MCPHS lists the Fennell Atrium as open 24 hours and allows food in designated study-and-socialize spaces.

cards.title: Use the Griffin second-floor lobby for quiet work
cards.subtitle: Griffin Building, second floor
cards.notes: Choose this lobby when you need a quiet-study option outside the library; MCPHS specifically names the second-floor lobby in its quiet-space list.
cards.short_summary: A named Griffin Building quiet-study lobby outside the main library setting.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS lists the Griffin second-floor lobby among its quiet study spaces.
cards.access_notes: MCPHS designates this lobby for quiet study; the page does not state separate hours.
